itens.titulo: Bank of America Shares Slide 8% on Record OCC Fine and Trading Miss
itens.descricao: Bank of America Shares Slide 8% on Record OCC Fine and Trading Miss Yahoo Finance
trechos: Tell us how you invest and we'll show you why it's our #1 pick.

Less than 15 hours before Bank of America reported, regulators hit it with $1.21 billion in fines for money laundering and sanctions violations, the biggest penalty the Office of the Comptroller of the Currency has ever levied.
The fine knocked 17 cents off earnings, leaving EPS at 91 cents against $1.10 expected.
Take the fine out and you get $1.08, which… still misses.
Profit fell 17% to $6.93 billion.
Revenue rose 3.2% to $30.12 billion, about $570 million short of estimates, and the shares fell as much as 8% Wednesday morning.
Fixed income dropped 17% to $2.55 billion, about $450 million under estimates, on weak mortgages, munis, and credit.
Equities rose 10% to $2.51 billion and still missed by nearly $300 million.

itens.titulo: Petrobras (PETR4): pagamento bilionário e acordo de US$ 859 milhões; de onde vem o dinheiro?
itens.descricao: Petrobras (PETR4): pagamento bilionário e acordo de US$ 859 milhões; de onde vem o dinheiro? Suno - Investimentos Inteligentes
trechos: Negócios Petrobras (PETR4): pagamento bilionário e acordo de US$ 859 milhões; de onde vem o dinheiro?
Um acerto de contas no petróleo e novos pagamentos por combustíveis colocaram duas cifras bilionárias nos comunicados da Petrobras (PETR4).
A companhia informou nesta terça-feira (13) que recebeu cerca de R$ 2,8 bilhões em subvenções à gasolina e ao diesel.
Separadamente, assinou acordos que lhe darão direito a aproximadamente US$ 859 milhões, com pagamento até novembro.
A maior parcela recebida foi de R$ 2,3 bilhões, referente ao diesel comercializado entre 1º e 15 de julho, nos termos da Medida Provisória nº 1.363.

A empresa também recebeu R$ 467,7 milhões pela comercialização de gasolina no mesmo intervalo, conforme a MP nº 1.358, e R$ 39,6 milhões de valor residual relativo ao diesel vendido em 1º de junho, sob a MP nº 1.340.
A partir de 2 de junho, a Petrobras aderiu ao programa da MP nº 1.363 e interrompeu sua habilitação ao anterior.
Com os novos recebimentos, o total acumulado nos programas de subvenção ao diesel, à gasolina e ao GLP, o gás de cozinha, chegou a cerca de R$ 16 bilhões.

itens.titulo: Palantir drops City Hall legal fight over Met deal
itens.descricao: Palantir drops City Hall legal fight over Met deal BBC
trechos: Palantir drops City Hall legal fight over Met deal Palantir has dropped its High Court challenge against the mayor of London's policing office over a blocked £50m deal with the Metropolitan Police.
Instead, in a joint statement on Wednesday, it said the decision was "not based on Palantir's values or ethics" and that the company was "free and welcomed" to bid when the contract is re-run.
"MOPAC is happy to correct any contrary impression," it said, adding that it "does not have, and has never had, any policy of not contracting with Palantir".
It said its decision had been based on its legal duty to examine spending proposals and ensure value for money, and that it was working with the Met to re-run the contract "with all due expediency".
Palantir filed a lawsuit in June, arguing that MOPAC had imposed an "unlawful veto" by wrongly taking its "values and ethics" into account, which MOPAC denied.
Met Commissioner Sir Mark Rowley said in June that the force's process had been "legally and commercially compliant" and warned that services and staff might have to be cut.
He told the London Policing Board the Palantir system would have allowed the Met to cut 500 jobs in response to a budget shortfall of £100m this year and £125m next year.
The force's 2026-27 budget included plans to cut 1,150 jobs, with the work of 500 of those to be done by AI tools to speed up intelligence reports and the analysis of mobile phones.
